title: Consequences if you hole out with a wrong ball
question: If you putt a wrong ball into the hole on the green and do not fix your mistake before starting the next hole or leaving the green (in stroke play), what can happen?

choices.text: Nothing, you continue the round as normal
You get a two-stroke penalty, but keep playing
You may be disqualified for not correcting the mistake
You subtract two strokes from your score

explanation: If you do not correct the mistake of holing out with a wrong ball in stroke play, you can be disqualified.
